description: This file defines UI layout constants, a custom NSPanel subclass, and an enum for canvas presentation options in a macOS application.

classes.name: CanvasPanel
classes.description: A subclass of NSPanel that allows it to become key and main window.

methods.name: canBecomeKey
methods.description: Overridden property indicating the panel can become key window.

methods.name: canBecomeMain
methods.description: Overridden property indicating the panel can become main window.

methods.name: isPanel
methods.description: Computed property returning true if CanvasPresentation is of type panel.
